cap.cap.m1.desc: Общий объем выпуска прецизионных титановых компонентов по всем производственным уровням — от прототипа до серийного производства больших объемов.
cap.cap.m2.desc: Совокупная месячная операционная мощность многоосевых обрабатывающих центров с ЧПУ.
cap.cap.m3.desc: Парк станков, специализирующийся исключительно на обработке реактивных и твердых металлов — Ti-6Al-4V, Grade 2, Grade 23 и никель-кобальтовых суперсплавов.
cap.cap.m4.desc: Непрерывная автоматизированная смена паллет с роботизированной загрузкой заготовок, минимизирующая время простоя персонала и максимизирующая OEE.
cap.cap.mat.title: От прототипа до
cap.cap.mat.sub: Три различных производственных уровня, разработанных для соответствия зрелости вашей программы.
cap.cap.mat.note: Производственные уровни не являются фиксированными границами. Программы могут плавно переходить от прототипа к массовому производству в рамках единого плана качества.
cap.cap.mr1.f: Быстрое развертывание CAD/CAM, проверка траекторий инструмента, геометрическая осуществимость, подтверждение марки материала.
cap.cap.mr2.f: Оптимизация приспособлений, стабилизация времени цикла, отчетность CMM на ранних этапах, квалификация процесса.
cap.cap.mr3.f: Автоматизированное швейцарское точение, непрерывное фрезерование на многопаллетных станках, жесткий SPC-контроль, поставка по этапам.
cap.cap.res.title: Производственная устойчивость и
cap.cap.res.sub: Многоуровневые стратегии снижения рисков, разработанные для гарантии своевременной поставки.
cap.cap.res.mat_d: Обеспечивается долгосрочными стратегическими партнерствами с титановыми заводами первого уровня. На нашем складе хранится стратегический страховой запас Grade 5, Grade 23 и Grade 2.
cap.cap.res.mach_t: Избыточность оборудования и переключение с нулевым простоем
cap.cap.res.mach_d: Каждая критическая спецификация станка дублируется резервными станками того же типа в нашем парке. Производственные программы могут быть перенесены в течение 2 часов без влияния на критический путь поставки.

capabilities.manufacturing.processes.sub: Трехосевая, пятиосевая, швейцарская токарная обработка и электроэрозионная обработка проволокой — все дисциплины аддитивного производства, специально разработанные для уникальных металлургических задач титана.
capabilities.manufacturing.processes.car: Полное 5-осевое одновременное контурирование для сложных аэрокосмических монолитных шпангоутов, медицинских ортопедических имплантатов и тонкостенных конструкционных компонентов. Обработка без прерываний сокращает количество ошибок при установке и сокращает время выполнения заказа.
Прецизионная токарная обработка на швейцарских станках

Токарная обработка швейцарского типа со скользящей шпиндельной бабкой для микроскопических титановых крепежных элементов, костных винтов, дентальных абатментов и длинновальных компонентов. Высокообъемное производство обеспечивает микронную повторяемость на миллионах деталей.
Электроэрозионная обработка проволокой и прошивная ЭЭО

Термическая эрозия без механического напряжения для сверхтвердых титановых сплавов. Позволяет получать острые внутренние углы (ø проволоки 0,1 мм), микропазы и тонкостенные элементы, недоступные для традиционного инструмента.
capabilities.manufacturing.specs.title: Прецизионные
capabilities.manufacturing.specs.subtitl: Сертифицированные показатели точности для инженеров-закупщиков — каждый диапазон допусков проверен с помощью внутренней КИМ-метрологии в соответствии со стандартами ASME Y14.5 и ISO 2768.
capabilities.manufacturing.specs.note: Все указанные допуски отражают достижимые производственные возможности на квалифицированных марках титана. Более жесткие допуски возможны после инженерного анализа. Также доступна поддержка сплавов Hi-Ni, Hi-Cr, Co-Cr.
capabilities.manufacturing.quality.title: Строгая инфраструктура качества и
соответствие EEAT
capabilities.manufacturing.quality.subti: Каждый титановый компонент подкреплен сертифицированными системами качества, полной прослеживаемостью материалов по цепочке поставок и многоэтапным контролем — в соответствии с принципами Google: Опыт, Экспертиза, Авторитетность и Доверие (EEAT).
capabilities.manufacturing.quality.as910: Стандарт менеджмента качества в аэрокосмической отрасли

Полномасштабная система менеджмента качества AS9100D, охватывающая проектирование, разработку, производство и поставку титановых аэрокосмических компонентов. Регулярные наблюдательные аудиты обеспечивают постоянное соответствие.
capabilities.manufacturing.quality.iso13: Управление процессами в соответствии с ISO 13485 для производства титановых компонентов медицинского назначения, включая хирургические имплантаты, ортопедические инструменты и зубные протезы.
capabilities.manufacturing.quality.iso90: Базовая структура менеджмента качества с документированными процессами постоянного улучшения, корректирующих/предупреждающих действий и ориентации на заказчика.

100% верификация PMI химического состава титанового сплава с помощью оптической эмиссионной спектрометрии (OES) и рентгенофлуоресцентных (XRF) анализаторов, обеспечивающая соответствие марки материала перед любой механической обработкой.
Сквозная цифровая прослеживаемость партий от входного контроля до финальной упаковки с сериализацией и штрихкодированием на каждой производственной операции.
capabilities.manufacturing.faq.title: Часто задаваемые
capabilities.manufacturing.faq.subtitle: Прямые технические ответы на наиболее часто задаваемые в Google вопросы закупщиков и инженеров титановых компонентов с высокой коммерческой заинтересованностью.
capabilities.manufacturing.faq.q1: Как BOZE CNC контролирует износ инструмента при обработке титана Grade 5?
capabilities.manufacturing.faq.a1: Мы используем высокожесткие 5-осевые станки, специальный твердосплавный инструмент с покрытием (многослойные PVD-покрытия AlTiN + TiAlN) и высоконапорную СОЖ через шпиндель (> 70 бар / 1 015 PSI) для активного подавления наклепа и тепловыделения при резании Ti-6Al-4V. Стратегии траекторий инструмента включают переменные углы наклона винтовой линии и трохоидальное фрезерование для равномерного распределения тепловой нагрузки, обеспечивая микронную стабильность размеров в течение длительных производственных циклов. Износ инструмента контролируется в цикле с помощью датчиков нагрузки шпинделя и акустической эмиссии.
capabilities.manufacturing.faq.q2: Можно ли обработать Ti-6Al-4V на станках с ЧПУ с допуском 5 микрон для медицинских имплантатов?
capabilities.manufacturing.faq.a2: Да. Наша производственная среда с контролируемой температурой (20 ±1°C) в сочетании с высокожесткими 5-осевыми платформами ЧПУ и системами термокомпенсации в реальном времени позволяет стабильно достигать размерных допусков ±0,005 мм (5 микрон) на компонентах медицинских имплантатов из Ti-6Al-4V ELI (Grade 23). Контроль первой детали (FAI) по AS9102 и 100% отчетность по размерам на КИМ ZEISS с точностью 1,9 мкм обеспечивают полную верификацию. Cpk ≥ 1,67 поддерживается на всех критических элементах имплантатов.
capabilities.manufacturing.faq.q3: Каков типичный срок изготовления нестандартной титановой детали, обработанной на станке с ЧПУ?
capabilities.manufacturing.faq.a3: Стандартные сроки изготовления составляют от 2 до 4 недель для быстрого прототипирования (1–10 шт.) и от 4 до 8 недель для серийного производства (100–5 000+ шт.), в зависимости от сложности, требований к сертификации материалов и спецификации финишной обработки. Ускоренный анализ технологичности (DFM) доступен в течение 24 часов после получения CAD-файла. Наш собственный запас сырья, включающий Grade 2, Grade 5 и Grade 23, исключает задержки, связанные с поставками с завода для стандартных размеров.
capabilities.manufacturing.faq.q4: Предоставляете ли вы полную прослеживаемость материалов и сертифицированные протоколы испытаний?
capabilities.manufacturing.faq.a4: Безусловно. Каждая поставка включает протоколы испытаний на заводе-изготовителе (MTR) по EN 10204 Тип 3.1, документирующие химический состав, механические свойства и прослеживаемость термообработки. Мы поддерживаем полную документацию по цепочке поставок от завода до готового компонента. Независимая инспекция третьей стороной (SGS, TÜV или Bureau Veritas) доступна по запросу. Все данные контроля архивируются и доступны для поиска в течение всего срока службы изделия.
capabilities.manufacturing.faq.q5: Какими сертификатами качества обладает BOZE CNC для производства титана?
capabilities.manufacturing.faq.a5: BOZE CNC работает в рамках системы качества, соответствующей AS9100 Rev D (аэрокосмическая отрасль), ISO 13485:2016 (медицинские изделия) и ISO 9001:2015. Наши производственные процессы и системы менеджмента качества разработаны для удовлетворения строгих требований аэрокосмической, медицинской, оборонной и промышленной отраслей. Мы поддерживаем аккредитованные Nadcap возможности неразрушающего контроля и следуем протоколам контроля первой детали AS9102.

capabilities.engineering.faq.q1: How to reduce stress concentration in thin-walled Grade 5 titanium aerospace components?
capabilities.engineering.faq.a1: Our engineering team applies three primary strategies. First, we increase fillet radii at all internal intersections to minimum R 1.5 mm to reduce Kt (stress concentration factor) below 1.5. Second, we replace sharp edge transitions with blended tangent arcs using 5-axis toolpath smoothing. Third, we specify low-stress grinding (LSG) or chemical milling for final surface removal of the alpha-case layer (0.05–0.10 mm) that forms during solution heat treatment of Ti-6Al-4V, eliminating micro-crack initiation sites.
capabilities.engineering.faq.q2: What is included in a standard DFM review for titanium CNC parts?
capabilities.engineering.faq.a2: A comprehensive DFM review covers six dimensions: (1) Material selection — verifying grade choice against functional requirements; (2) Feature machinability — assessing wall thickness, corner radii, depth-to-diameter ratios, and thread specifications for titanium-specific limitations; (3) Tolerance stack analysis — evaluating cumulative dimensional effects across multi-feature parts using Monte Carlo simulation; (4) Tool access — confirming all features are reachable with standard tool lengths and extensions; (5) Fixturing strategy — recommending workholding approach (vise, tombstone, vacuum chuck, or custom fixture) based on part geometry and rigidity; (6) Cost optimization — identifying opportunities to reduce cycle time through feature consolidation or tolerance relaxation.
capabilities.engineering.faq.q3: How can BOZE engineering reduce cycle times for existing titanium production programs?
capabilities.engineering.faq.a3: Our value engineering team conducts a systematic cycle time analysis across four dimensions: Toolpath optimization — converting conventional roughing to adaptive clearing with high-feed mills, reducing roughing time by up to 40%; Process consolidation — combining milling, drilling, and tapping operations on multi-tasking mill-turn platforms, eliminating secondary setups; Cutting tool selection — selecting grade-specific carbide inserts with optimized chip-breaker geometries for titanium; and Workholding efficiency — reducing part loading/unloading time through quick-change pallet systems. Typical first-pass cycle time reduction: 15–25% without capital equipment investment.
capabilities.engineering.faq.q4: Which CAD/CAM software platforms does BOZE engineering support?
capabilities.engineering.faq.a4: Our engineering team works with all major CAD/CAM platforms. We accept native files from SolidWorks, Autodesk Inventor, and PTC Creo, and neutral formats including STEP, IGES, and Parasolid. For CAM programming, we use Mastercam (5-axis simultaneous, mill-turn, and wire EDM modules) and Siemens NX CAM for complex freeform surface machining. All toolpaths are validated through full-machine digital twin simulation with collision detection, spindle load monitoring, and surface finish prediction before production release.

capabilities.capacity.resilience.subtitl: In an industry where titanium supply disruptions and production bottlenecks are the norm, BOZE operates through a deliberately engineered resilience framework.
capabilities.capacity.faq.subtitle: Strategic answers to the procurement questions that matter most when evaluating a high-volume titanium machining partner.
capabilities.capacity.faq.q1: What is BOZE's typical lead time for high-volume titanium production orders (5,000+ pcs)?
capabilities.capacity.faq.a1: For established production programs with released tooling and qualified inspection protocols, standard lead time is 4–6 weeks from confirmed purchase order to first shipment. This includes material procurement (Grade 5, Grade 23, Grade 2), batch setup on multi-spindle machines, first-article inspection per AS9102, and staged delivery scheduling. Expedited lead times of 2–3 weeks are available for strategic programs through our fast-track manufacturing cell, which reserves dedicated spindle capacity for qualified production programs. Lead time guarantees are contractually committed through our supply assurance program.
capabilities.capacity.faq.q2: How does BOZE ensure production continuity during supply chain disruptions?
capabilities.capacity.faq.a2: Through a three-layer resilience architecture: (1) Redundant spindle capacity — our machine park operates at 70% utilization as standard, leaving 30% surge capacity for emergency demand spikes or unscheduled downtime recovery; (2) Multi-region material sourcing — each production-critical titanium grade has at least two qualified mill sources across different geographic regions; (3) Inventory buffer — we carry 8–12 weeks of forecasted Grade 5, Grade 23, and Grade 2 inventory, allowing production to continue uninterrupted through all but the most severe supply chain events.
capabilities.capacity.faq.q3: Can BOZE handle both prototype R&D and mass production under one roof?
capabilities.capacity.faq.a3: Yes. Our production scaling matrix is designed specifically for programs that mature from concept to volume. Prototype and R&D orders (1–10 pcs) are managed by our dedicated engineering team with rapid CAM deployment and aggressive 3–7 day lead times. As the program validates and volumes increase, the same toolpaths, fixtures, and inspection programs migrate seamlessly into our low-volume high-mix (LVHM) cell and eventually into high-volume mass production — all under a single quality plan with no re-qualification required.
capabilities.capacity.faq.q4: How do you guarantee raw material supply stability for long-term production programs?
capabilities.capacity.faq.a4: Through three coordinated strategies: Strategic mill partnerships — we maintain long-term framework agreements with tier-1 titanium mills (including VSMPO-AVISMA, ATI Metals, and BaoTi Group), guaranteeing allocated production capacity and preferential pricing; Strategic inventory — our warehouse carries 8–12 weeks of forecasted demand for Grade 5, Grade 23, and Grade 2 in bar, plate, and billet forms, fully certified with EN 10204 3.1 MTRs; Alternative source qualification — we proactively qualify alternative mill sources for every program-critical grade, ensuring a qualified backup supply chain is ready before any disruption occurs.

page_quality.workflow.subtitle: Rigorous inbound inspection (IQC), in-process quality control (IPQC), and final outbound quality control (OQC) — every stage gated and documented.
page_quality.workflow.step1_desc: Incoming raw material verification against purchase order specifications including material grade confirmation via PMI (Positive Material Identification) using Optical Emission Spectrometry (OES). Dimensional verification of bar/plate/billet dimensions and surface condition assessment. Material Test Reports cross-referenced against the heat number and stored in our ERP system for full lot traceability.
page_quality.workflow.step2_desc: Real-time dimensional and surface quality monitoring during machining operations. Operators perform first-article inspection per AS9102 upon machine setup, followed by statistical process control checks at defined intervals. CMM in-process sampling verifies critical features before secondary operations proceed.
page_quality.workflow.step3_desc: Final comprehensive inspection before shipment including 100% CMM dimensional inspection (where specified), surface roughness verification, thread gauge testing, and visual inspection under controlled lighting. All results recorded in Certificate of Conformance and inspection reports shipped with each order.

page_quality.metrology.metric3_desc: Annual non-destructive testing capacity across fluorescent dye penetrant (FPI) inspection, ultrasonic (UT) thickness gauging, and eddy current surface crack detection. NDT Level II and III certified personnel.

page_quality.faq.title: Compliance & Inspection
page_quality.faq.subtitle: Answers to the most frequent quality assurance questions from aerospace and medical procurement engineers.
page_quality.faq.q1: Which quality certifications does BOZE CNC hold for titanium manufacturing?
page_quality.faq.a1: BOZE CNC Metal’s quality management system is certified to AS9100D (Aerospace), ISO 13485:2016 (Medical Devices), and ISO 9001:2015 (General Quality). Our Nadcap accreditation covers NDT processes (fluorescent dye penetrant inspection and ultrasonic testing). All certifications are issued by accredited international registrars with current scope available for customer review upon request.
page_quality.faq.q2: How do you ensure material traceability from mill to finished part?
page_quality.faq.a2: Every incoming raw material batch is logged with a unique lot number in our ERP system that links to the original heat number, MTR, CMM inspection results, and production traveler. This provides complete forward and backward traceability — from finished part back to the original mill batch.
page_quality.faq.q3: What inspection equipment is used for dimensional validation of titanium parts?
page_quality.faq.a3: Our in-house metrology lab is equipped with a ZEISS CMM (bridge-type, 1.9 μm volumetric accuracy), OGP SmartScope optical comparators, and Mitutoyo SJ-410 surface roughness testers. For material verification, we use a SPECTROMAXx Optical Emission Spectrometer for rapid PMI analysis. NDT capabilities include fluorescent dye penetrant (FPI) and ultrasonic (UT) testing. All inspection equipment is calibrated per ISO 17025 traceable standards with calibration certificates available on request.
page_quality.faq.q4: What quality documentation is included with each shipment?
page_quality.faq.a4: Each shipment includes a comprehensive quality dossier containing: Certified Mill Test Reports (MTRs) per EN 10204 Type 3.1 documenting raw material composition and mechanical properties; Certificate of Conformance (CoC) confirming all manufacturing and inspection processes meet customer specifications; CMM dimensional inspection reports with actual vs. nominal measurements per ASME Y14.5 GD&T; and Surface roughness certification where required. AS9102-compliant First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) are provided for aerospace programs upon request.
page_quality.cta.text: Request our quality management brochure or schedule a facility audit.
page_quality.metrology.cmm_desc: Automated 3D dimensional analysis capturing tolerances down to ±0.0015 mm. Multi-axis scanning with active vibration dampening for micron-level accuracy on complex titanium geometries.
page_quality.metrology.xrf_desc: Instant, non-destructive chemical composition analysis of incoming titanium lots. Confirms elemental makeup within 30 seconds, ensuring every batch matches the specified grade chemistry per ASTM E415.
page_quality.metrology.vision_desc: Non-contact high-resolution optical inspection for fragile micro-features and precise micro-inch surface roughness (Ra) certification. Optical comparators for 2D profile verification of complex titanium geometries.
capabilities.capacity.resilience.card1_d: Maintained through long-term strategic partnerships with tier-1 titanium mills. Our warehouse carries strategic safety stock of Grade 5 (Ti-6Al-4V), Grade 23 (ELI), and Grade 2 in bar, plate, and near-net forged forms — insulating your program from international raw material price volatility, mill allocation constraints, or geopolitical supply disruptions. Typical raw material coverage: 8-12 weeks of forecasted production demand.
capabilities.capacity.resilience.card2_d: Every critical machine specification (5-axis milling, Swiss turning, wire EDM) is backed by redundant sister machines within our fleet. In the event of an unexpected tool collision, spindle fault, or mechanical failure, production programs are transferred to an identical backup machine within 2 hours — zero impact to the critical delivery path. CAM programs, fixture offsets, and inspection protocols are pre-loaded and validated across multiple machines as standard practice.
cap.inspectionpage.s2.subtitle: Beyond dimensional inspection, we offer a full suite of specialized testing services to validate material integrity, mechanical properties, and long-term reliability of titanium components.
cap.inspectionpage.s2.card1.desc: Surface flaw detection for titanium components using high-sensitivity fluorescent penetrants. Capable of detecting cracks, porosity, laps, and seams as fine as 1 µm wide. Performed in dedicated clean-room conditions with UV inspection booths. Nadcap-accredited processes available for aerospace and medical applications.
cap.inspectionpage.s2.card1.val1: Crack detection down to 1 µm width
cap.inspectionpage.s2.card2.desc: Volumetric examination for subsurface discontinuities in titanium — including inclusions, voids, and delaminations. Immersion and contact UT methods available for complex geometries. Full C-scan imaging provides permanent record of internal material integrity.
cap.inspectionpage.s2.card3.desc: Comprehensive 3D dimensional analysis using programmatic CMM cycles. Every GD&T callout per ASME Y14.5 — including flatness, concentricity, true position, profile of a surface, and runout — is verified against engineering specifications. Detailed color-coded deviation plots provided.
cap.inspectionpage.s2.card4.title: Mechanical Properties & Tensile Testing
cap.inspectionpage.s2.card4.desc: Verification of tensile strength, yield strength, elongation, and hardness for titanium material verification. Hardness testing per Rockwell C and Brinell scales. Tensile testing per ASTM E8/E8M on qualified sub-contract partner equipment with full accreditation.
cap.inspectionpage.s2.card4.val2: ASTM E8/E8M, ASTM E18, ASTM E10
cap.inspectionpage.s3.subtitle: Systematic inspection sequence ensuring every titanium component meets or exceeds specified requirements before shipment.
cap.inspectionpage.s3.step1.title: Material Verification & PMI
cap.inspectionpage.s3.step1.desc: Every incoming titanium lot is tested using OES spectrometry for positive material identification. Chemical composition is verified against the certified mill test report (EN 10204 3.1 MTR). Only material matching specified grade chemistry is released to production.
cap.inspectionpage.s3.step2.desc: First machined part from each production run undergoes 100% layout inspection on CMM. Full AS9102-compliant FAIR with ballooned drawings, actual vs. nominal measurements, and GD&T verification. Review and sign-off by senior quality inspector before production release.
cap.inspectionpage.s3.step3.desc: On-machine probing and statistical process control (SPC) for real-time dimensional monitoring. Control charts track critical features. Surface roughness verification at defined intervals. Tool wear monitoring through spindle load analysis.
cap.inspectionpage.s3.step4.desc: Final dimensional gating using programmatic CMM cycles on sampled or 100% of parts. Surface finish certification. NDT (FPI/UT) where specified. Comprehensive quality dossier compiled — including MTRs, CMM reports, CoC, and inspection certificates.
cap.inspectionpage.s4.subtitle: Detailed specifications of our inspection and metrology equipment — all maintained under strict ISO 17025 calibration schedules.
cap.inspectionpage.s5.title: Procurement
cap.inspectionpage.s5.subtitle: Answers to the most common inspection and testing questions from procurement engineers.
cap.inspectionpage.s5.a1: Our in-house metrology lab is equipped with a ZEISS CONTURA G2 CMM (bridge-type, 1.9 µm volumetric accuracy), OGP SmartScope optical comparators, and Mitutoyo SJ-410 surface roughness testers. For material verification, we use a SPECTROMAXx Optical Emission Spectrometer for rapid PMI analysis. All equipment is calibrated per ISO 17025 traceable standards with full calibration certificates on file.
cap.inspectionpage.s5.a2: Inspection scope is determined by customer specification and part criticality. High-volume production typically follows AQL-based sampling (ANSI/ASQ Z1.4) with CMM verification at defined intervals. Critical aerospace and medical components receive 100% dimensional inspection with full CMM reports. First-article inspection (FAI) per AS9102 is standard for all new programs. Surface roughness, NDT, and material certification are added per engineering requirements.
cap.inspectionpage.s5.a3: We offer Fluorescent Penetrant Inspection (FPI) per ASTM E1417 for surface crack detection down to 1 µm width, and Ultrasonic Testing (UT) per ASTM E2375 for subsurface volumetric examination. Our NDT processes are Nadcap-accredited for aerospace applications. Additional capabilities include eddy current testing for surface conductivity verification and leak testing for sealed assemblies.
cap.inspectionpage.s5.a4: Yes. Every shipment includes a comprehensive quality dossier containing: (1) Certified Mill Test Reports (MTRs) per EN 10204 Type 3.1; (2) Certificate of Conformance (CoC); (3) CMM dimensional inspection reports with GD&T verification; (4) Surface roughness certification; and (5) NDT reports where specified. AS9102 FAIR documentation is provided for aerospace programs. All records are archived and retrievable.
cap.inspectionpage.s5.cta: Have specific inspection requirements? Contact our quality engineering team.
cap.traceabilitypage.s1.subtitle: From raw titanium ingot heat lots to permanently marked finished components — every transfer, test, and transformation is digitally recorded and cross-referenced for complete forward and backward traceability.
cap.traceabilitypage.s1.step1.desc: Every incoming titanium bar, plate, or sheet is placed under quarantine upon arrival. The certified EN 10204 Type 3.1 Mill Test Report (MTR) is digitally cross-checked against the physical material heat number stamped on each piece. A unique internal batch number is generated in our ERP system and permanently linked to the mill’s native heat number — creating the first link in the chain of custody.
cap.traceabilitypage.s1.step2.desc: Once released from quarantine, raw stock is physically laser-marked with grade identification and color-coded by titanium grade (Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V, Grade 23 ELI, Grade 2 CP) in dedicated inventory zones. Handheld XRF spectrometers perform Positive Material Identification (PMI) to confirm chemical composition before any stock is released to the production floor. Material lots are physically segregated to prevent any cross-contamination between grades.
cap.traceabilitypage.s1.step3.desc: As material moves to multi-axis CNC machining cells, the internal batch ID is digitally bound to the ERP production traveler job routing. Each operation — milling, turning, wire EDM, surface treatment — records the machine ID, operator, and timestamp against the same batch number. Scrap and raw metal turnings are segregated by grade in dedicated containers to prevent cross-contamination. The system supports full forward traceability (from heat to finished part) and backward traceability (from finished part back to heat).
cap.traceabilitypage.s1.step4.desc: Finished parts undergo permanent micro-laser-marking per blueprint requirements — serial numbers, heat IDs, date codes, or QR codes (Data Matrix per MIL-STD-130 / UDI compliance). The complete quality dossier — including MTR, CMM report, FAIR, surface roughness certificate, and CoC — is digitally archived under the part serial number and heat lot identifier. All records are retained for a minimum of 10 years and retrievable within 24 hours for customer or regulatory audit support.
cap.traceabilitypage.s2.subtitle: Every titanium component is manufactured in full alignment with international defense, aerospace, medical, and environmental compliance frameworks.
cap.traceabilitypage.s2.row2.req: Material certificate issued by the mill showing actual chemical composition and physical tensile test results — not generic compliance statements.
cap.traceabilitypage.s2.row3.req: Maintains explicit identification and status indicators throughout total production cycles — identification, status, traceability per AS9100D risk management.
cap.traceabilitypage.s3.subtitle: Your quality documentation doesn’t expire after shipment. We maintain comprehensive digital archives to support regulatory audits, downstream investigations, and procurement compliance reviews — often years after project completion.
cap.traceabilitypage.s3.card1.desc: All quality dossiers — including Mill Test Reports (MTRs), CMM dimensional reports, First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR), surface roughness certificates, and Certificates of Conformance (CoC) — are digitally archived on redundant servers with off-site backup for a minimum of 10 years. Records are indexed by part number, heat number, customer PO, and date range for rapid retrieval.
cap.traceabilitypage.s3.card2.desc: When your quality or procurement team faces an audit, customer investigation, or downstream supplier investigation, we can retrieve and deliver the complete quality dossier for any historical order within 24 hours. Our document control team is trained to support auditor requests, providing certified copies of original MTRs, inspection reports, and process certifications.
cap.traceabilitypage.s4.subtitle: Answers to the most critical material traceability and compliance questions from procurement and regulatory teams.
cap.traceabilitypage.s4.a1: Every shipment includes a comprehensive quality dossier containing: (1) Certified Mill Test Report (MTR) per EN 10204 Type 3.1 documenting chemical composition, mechanical properties, and heat treatment parameters; (2) Certificate of Conformance (CoC) confirming all manufacturing and inspection processes meet specifications; (3) Heat number and batch lot traceability linking the finished component back to the original mill ingot; and (4) CMM dimensional inspection reports with GD&T verification. Additional documentation — including DFARS compliance certificates, RoHS/REACH declarations, and AS9102 FAIR — is available upon request.
cap.traceabilitypage.s4.a2: Yes. BOZE CNC is fully capable of supporting DFARS 252.225-7014 compliant production. Upon procurement request, we can source titanium that is melted in the United States or other qualifying countries (Australia, Canada, Japan, Sweden, Belgium, United Kingdom). The DFARS compliance certificate and corresponding mill origin documentation are provided as part of the quality dossier. We recommend specifying DFARS requirements at the time of RFQ to ensure appropriate material sourcing and segregation.
cap.traceabilitypage.s4.a3: We employ micro-laser-marking for permanent part identification — including serial numbers, heat lot IDs, date codes, and Data Matrix (QR) codes. Laser marking is preferred over inkjet or chemical etching for its permanence, readability through surface treatments (anodizing, passivation), and compliance with MIL-STD-130 (DoD item identification) and UDI (Unique Device Identification for medical devices). Marking parameters are validated for each titanium grade to ensure legibility without compromising fatigue performance or corrosion resistance.
cap.traceabilitypage.s4.a4: All quality records are retained for a minimum of 10 years from the date of shipment. Records are stored on redundant digital servers with off-site backup and are indexed by part number, heat number, customer purchase order, and date range. In the event of an audit, recall, or customer quality investigation, our document control team can retrieve and deliver the complete quality dossier within 24 hours. Certified copies of original MTRs and inspection reports are available upon request.
cap.traceabilitypage.s4.cta: Have specific compliance requirements for your titanium program?
cap.certificationspage.s1.subtitle: Our production infrastructure operates under a highly audited, internationally recognized quality management system. Validated by world-leading registrars, every certification guarantees uncompromising regulatory and safety compliance.
cap.certificationspage.s1.as9100_subtitl: Aerospace structural brackets, engine components, landing gear, hydraulic manifolds, propulsion hardware and flight-critical titanium parts.
cap.certificationspage.s1.iso13485_subti: Sterile surgical instrument trays, implant components, bone screw fixation systems, precision orthopedic devices, and Class II medical hardware.
cap.certificationspage.s1.iso9001_subtit: General industrial components, automotive performance parts, oil & gas valve assemblies, automation equipment, and custom-engineered hardware across all commercial sectors.
cap.certificationspage.s2.subtitle: A complete overview of BOZE’s active quality management certifications — each verified by world-leading registrars through annual surveillance audits.
cap.certificationspage.s2.row1_col3: Multi-axis titanium machining for high-stress structural parts, propulsion components, and critical flight hardware.
cap.certificationspage.s3.subtitle: Certification is not a static badge — it is a dynamic, continuously verified system. Our compliance framework is tested quarterly internally and validated annually by independent third-party registrars.
cap.certificationspage.s3.phase1_desc: Our certified internal quality auditors conduct scheduled cross-departmental reviews every quarter to ensure total adherence to AS9100D and ISO 13485 operational clauses. Any non-conformities are logged, tracked, and resolved through our CAPA system before they can impact production quality.
cap.certificationspage.s3.phase2_desc: Leading international registrars (SGS, TÜV SÜD, BSI) perform rigorous on-site surveillance audits annually. Auditors verify tool calibration logs, material traceability data, process control documentation, and employee competency records against the relevant standard’s clause requirements.
cap.certificationspage.s3.phase3_desc: Any process variance — whether identified internally or during registrar audits — triggers our formal Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) workflow. Root-cause analysis (5-Why, Fishbone, FMEA) is applied to determine systemic causes, and engineering protocols, toolpath strategies, or inspection plans are updated accordingly.
cap.certificationspage.s4.subtitle: Answers to the most frequently asked questions about our manufacturing certifications, audit scope, and quality documentation from procurement and supplier quality engineers.
cap.certificationspage.s4.a1: Yes. Certified copies of our current AS9100D, ISO 13485:2016, and ISO 9001:2015 certificates are available upon request. Each certificate includes the official scope statement, registrar accreditation details, issue and expiry dates, and the unique certificate number. We can provide these as part of your supplier qualification package or directly to your procurement portal. Contact our quality management team via our RFQ page to request current certificates.
cap.certificationspage.s4.a2: Our quality management system is audited by internationally recognized registrars including SGS, DNV GL, and BSI. We undergo annual surveillance audits for each certification, with full re-certification audits every three years. In addition, our internal audit team conducts comprehensive cross-departmental reviews on a quarterly basis, ensuring continuous compliance between registrar visits. All audit findings — including observations, non-conformities, and corrective actions — are documented and traceable.
cap.certificationspage.s4.a3: Yes. AS9100 Rev D is the aerospace, space, and defense industry-specific quality management standard. Our certification scope explicitly covers the manufacture of precision machined components for aerospace structural assemblies, propulsion systems, and defense hardware. The standard incorporates all ISO 9001:2015 requirements plus additional aerospace-specific provisions including configuration management, counterfeit part prevention (AS6174/AS5553), first-article inspection (AS9102), and special process control. For defense contracts requiring DFARS compliance, we can additionally provide certified material sourcing from qualifying countries.
cap.certificationspage.s4.a4: At minimum, AS9100 Rev D requires an annual surveillance audit by the accredited registrar, with a full re-certification audit every 36 months. Between registrar visits, our internal audit team conducts quarterly internal audits across all departments. Additional audits may be triggered by major process changes, new facility additions, or customer-specific requirements. This multi-layer audit cadence ensures continuous compliance and immediate identification of any system gaps.
cap.certificationspage.s4.cta: Request our current certification documents for your supplier qualification process.
cap.certificationspage.s4.a0: BOZE CNC operates under three internationally recognized quality management certifications: AS9100 Rev D (aerospace and defense), ISO 13485:2016 (medical devices), and ISO 9001:2015 (general manufacturing). Each certification is maintained through annual surveillance audits conducted by accredited third-party registrars. Our AS9100D scope specifically covers precision 5-axis CNC machining of titanium alloys for aerospace structural and propulsion applications.
